summary: Business Hub Project Management & Billing Management UI Testing Complete. All 10 features verified working correctly. Project Management shows 372 projects from Project & Services with Live (93) and Completed (279) tabs. Billing Management has only 2 tabs (Progress Tracking and Weekly Billing) - NO Invoice tab as expected since user uses ZOHO Books.

BillingManagement.js correctly shows only 2 tabs (Progress Tracking, Weekly Billing) - Invoice tab removed
Subtitle correctly states 'Invoices in ZOHO Books' indicating external invoice management
All modals (View Details, View Requests, Raise Request) working correctly
Material/Vendor/Payment request functionality available from Project Management
